news.text: "#Juve, I Would Like To Have More Italian Players"#Carnevali's desireThe bianconero CEO: "Just finishing fourth isn't enough for us. The mercato is difficult, winning takes time"[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#SPALLETTI IS ALSO KEEPING AN EYE ON #LICINA#Juve (at 12:30 PM) reunites as a rival with the attacking midfielder loaned to #Cremonese and the star in Serie B. Test for #Kelly and #Cambiaso, but above all, a chance for young players and the reserves. #Neto makes his debut.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🚑 "For Jeremie #Boga and Jeff #Ekhator, the indications point to a possible return in November.Among the long-term injuries, the first to return should be Kenan #Yildiz: his recovery is proceeding according to schedule, and there are good chances of seeing him available again in December.For Manuel #Locatelli, the return timeline is between February and March. Khéphren #Thuram would return tentatively by the beginning of 2027."[@romeoagresti on SOS Fanta via @PuebloJ]

👀 "In terms of a starting role, and also considering the investment made, Randal #KoloMuani remains for now the primary attacking reference for #Juventus.Coexistence with Nick #Woltemade, however, is a concrete solution and represents an idea that Luciano #Spalletti has been working on.Over time, it cannot be ruled out that they might find playing time together on the pitch as well."[@romeoagresti on SOS Fanta via @PuebloJ]

👀 "Zeki #Çelik has been offering great reliability on the left flank for #Juventus and it is now difficult to imagine him losing his starting spot.Andrea #Cambiaso will have to raise the level of his performances to try and challenge him.Pay attention also to potential tactical solutions: the Italian could be utilized between the midfield and the more advanced wide positions"[@romeoagresti on SOS Fanta via @PuebloJ]

🔴 Probable #Juventus lineup for tomorrow's friendly match against #Cremonese: Neto; Gatti, Bremer, Kelly; Savio, Makiobo, Macca, Melegoni, Cambiaso; McKennie; Kolo Muani.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

#SPALLETTI"He does not need me to defend him.I think that during difficult moments, such as after the defeat against #Sassuolo, everything erupted against #Spalletti, but I know how extraordinary, capable and educational he is as a coach.If you were to come and watch his training sessions, your jaw would drop.Of course, everyone has their own character, but he has an enormous desire.We want to grow and work together.I wish we had more coaches like #Spalletti in our league."#CONTE"#Conte is a friend, I know he is a top-tier manager, but he never crossed our minds.Today we must focus on providing continuity. ℹ️💰 The €250M capital increase provides greater financial flexibility, but it is not entirely intended for the mercato. In January, the management will have some margin for the mercato, while respecting FFP boundaries: #Juventus might first need to carry out sales. On the incoming front they are primarily evaluating a left winger and a physical center-forward, while monitoring the performance of #Ekhator. If #Koopmeiners were to leave, a midfielder could also become a priority.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀❗️#Juventus is already working on potential free agents for the upcoming mercato sessions. For the goalkeeper position, eyes are on #Alisson and Santiago #Beltran. #Solet, #Raum and #Mitchell for the defense. In midfield, #Lobotka and #Kovacic are liked, while the big target for the attacking midfield is #BrahimDiaz, although signing him appears complex. In attack, #Mateta is being tracked.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🔛🧐 In January, priority goes to the midfield: #Hojbjerg is back in fashion, with the potential departure of #Koopmeiners likely to facilitate the deal. #Bakola among the alternatives. If #Cabal leaves, another attempt could be made for #AitNouri. In the summer, however, the priority is on the number 9. The stay of #Woltemade is difficult: #Sesko, #Balogun and #Brobbey are being monitored. Regarding the free agents, eyes are on #vanDijk, #Kovacic, #BrunoFernandes, #Raum and #Tomori.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇫🇷🆙 #KoloMuani has already returned to group training with a conspicuous bandage. The fracture does not prevent him from participating in the mini-games: he wants to exploit the international break to regain his condition and end his goal drought. #Spalletti is following him very closely, alternating between praise and tactical corrections to make him a more complete player.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

🇳🇱👀 #Juventus sent a scout to attend the Netherlands-Germany match to closely monitor #Brobbey and #vanDijk. The striker is highly liked for his characteristics, with an excellent relationship with the entourage. He costs around €40M. The defender, on the other hand, will see his contract expire in 2027 and is among the free agents being monitored alongside #Tomori, #Kovacic and #Raum.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

#JUVE, BACK AGAINST THE WALLS#Elkann's relaunchThe 250 million capital increase multiplies Lucio's responsibilities.Champions League obligation: pressure on #SpallettiQualification for the tournament of the giants is the only key to balancing #Exor's new financial intervention. Trap-filled calendar after the break: 9 matches in 29 days. From #Cambiaso's recovery run to the expectation surrounding #Kolo and #Woltemade.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#JUVE'S PARAMETERSFrom #Lobotka to #BrahimDiaz, from #Alisson to #Solet: here is #Massara's dossierThe sporting director is carefully evaluating 8 profiles with expiring contracts for a future leap in quality while containing costs: #Kovacic, #Beltran, #Raum and #Mateta are also on the list. #Mitchell from #CrystalPalace is also intriguing. Meanwhile, #Kolo is already taking the pitch with a broken finger just 9 days after surgery.#Marchisio and #Montero, second-generation talents under #Spalletti. [Front Page TuttoSport]

💎🔐 #Juventus wants to lock down the best talents from its youth sector well in advance. The primary name is #Elimoghale: a contract adjustment is being evaluated to ward off competition. The management also wants to increasingly maximize the value of Vinovo, transforming it into a source of both talent for the First Team and future mercato revenues. Among the young players already seeing their value is Davide #Marchisio.[Giovanni Albanese - Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "Due to the injuries to Manuel #Locatelli and Khéphren #Thuram, in addition to the underperformance of Teun #Koopmeiners, the priority for #Juventus is to sign a midfielder in January.The profile they are looking for is that of a young and talented player:▫️​Alessandro #Romano: The 18-year-old (born in 2006) from #Cagliari is of interest to #Juve.However, his price tag is already estimated at around €20M, and the Sardinian club paid just under €6M for him.#Inter and #Napoli are also tracking him.​▪️Darryl #Bakola: The 17-year-old French talent (born in 2007) signed by #Sassuolo from #OlympiquedeMarseille.#Juventus already attempted approaches for him at the end of August and his valuation

👀 "Many denials have been arriving.The club itself contacted me confirming the denial.However, based on reliable information, and subsequent confirmation yesterday, I know that, at the end of August and the beginning of September, the strongest name as an internal solution for the presidency of #Juventus was, and still is, Ginevra #Elkann.From Ginevra's side, there is availability and a desire to take the position.The only thing that is certain is that the parties have discussed it recently, that doesn't mean they haven't changed their minds."[@MatteMoretto on @juventibus via @PuebloJ]
